rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something intensely painful or causing prolonged suffering.

example.english: This long interrogation is really torturous.
example.traditional: 呢段漫長嘅審訊真係好折磨人嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 dyun6 maan6 coeng4 ge3 sam2 seon3 zan1 hai6 hou2 zit3 mo4 jan4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the painful or excruciating aspect when the focus is on the suffering itself rather than what causes it.

example.english: The days of waiting for the operation results were really torturous.
example.traditional: 等手術結果嗰幾日真係好痛苦嘅。
example.jyutping: dang2 sau2 seot6 git3 gwo2 go2 gei2 jat6 zan1 hai6 hou2 tung3 fu2 ge3

rows.jyutping: tung4 huk6 jing4 jau5 gwaan1 ge3
rows.note: Use this specifically when something relates to torture as a practice or legal concept.

example.english: The court has to hear torturous allegations related to torture.
example.traditional: 法庭要審理同酷刑有關嘅指控。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 jiu3 sam2 lei5 tung4 huk6 jing4 jau5 gwaan1 ge3 zi2 hung3
